summary: Google DeepMind launched Lyria 3.5, an updated music generation model, in Google Flow Music with improvements to musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control.

practices.reason: A consumer music generation model update improves output quality but is not a dimension most engineering teams build on.
practices.quote: Our newest music generation model, Lyria 3.5, delivers significant advancements across musicality, lyrics, and vocal quality, empowering you to craft richer tracks.
